review.rationale: Option A correctly preserves both the R1 offline-contract violation and the v0.1 review failure as immutable evidence. It bounds remediation to a single $id alignment in the common schema, enforces a strict local-only Registry with no remote fallback, and mandates exactly one new R2 validation after an independent Decision. The commit gate is fail-closed and limited to the 28-file package plus governance artifacts. All non-authorizations (no PR, merge, release, deployment, public fetch, model session, technical reuse, runtime, agent, entity, permission, or commercial claim) are explicitly preserved. The recommendation is a replacement, not a retry, and maintains the required separation between Evidence, Evaluation, Recommendation, Decision, and Execution.
